versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this release.

- No file changes detected from previous version.
- All features and documentation remain the same.

- Added comprehensive usage guide and best practices for the Smartlead CLI in SKILL.md.

- Documented safe deletion behavior and confirmation mechanisms for destructive operations.
